[{"insert":"Pronated Pull Up + Ring Row

This is a superset that starts with pronated pull ups, palms facing away, using a band or assistance if you need it to hit the reps and tempo. After a short 15 second rest, move to the ring row, which shifts you to a more horizontal angle where you can keep pulling once the vertical pull is smoked. Keep that switch tight.  The short rest is what makes this a drop set instead of two separate moves.
"}]
